quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, separate K-IFRS, reviewed by Sunghyun Accounting Corp; no subsidiaries so no consolidated statements): Q2 revenue KRW 143,187M, +27.3% YoY (Q2 2025: KRW 112,522M) and +43.5% QoQ (Q1 2026: KRW 99,771M); operating profit KRW 73,514M, +37.6% YoY (KRW 53,444M) - a 51.3% OP MARGIN; net income KRW 65,923M, +60.4% YoY (KRW 41,110M), EPS KRW 869. H1 2026: revenue KRW 242,959M (+27.2% YoY vs KRW 190,932M), OP KRW 120,814M (+36.7%, 49.7% margin), net income KRW 106,319M (+50.9%), EPS KRW 1,401; H1 other income included KRW 4,118M FX gains and KRW 4,315M FX translation gains. H1 MIX: IC TEST SOCKETS 68.48% (KRW 166,384M, exports KRW 157,052M / domestic KRW 9,333M) vs 65.48% in FY2025; LEENO PIN spring-contact probes 23.25% (KRW 56,487M, exports KRW 45,173M); ultrasound medical-device parts 7.65% (KRW 18,575M, mostly domestic); merchandise 0.62%. Exports 83.7% of H1 revenue (KRW 203,442M) vs domestic KRW 39,517M; pin/socket export:domestic ratio 9:1. Debt-free (borrowings zero), cash + bank deposits + bonds ~KRW 427B, equity KRW 776,764M; receivables jumped to KRW 101,645M from KRW 52,853M at 2025-12-31 on the Q2 shipment surge. FY2025 dividend KRW 800/share (KRW 60,716M, 39.96% payout) paid in H1; policy is ~30%+ payout, 3-year average ~40%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 rev KRW 143.2B (+27.3% YoY, +43.5% QoQ); OP KRW 73.5B (51.3% margin, +37.6% YoY); H1 rev KRW 243.0B (+27.2%), H1 OP KRW 120.8B (49.7%); sockets 68.5% of sales, exports 83.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Orders and customers (half-year report): Leeno reports no order backlog - it builds ~30,000 custom SKUs to order, ships standard items within 10 days of purchase order and special orders in 2-4 weeks, so customer purchase orders ARE the order book; section XI lists no disclosed supply contracts and 'contracts in progress: none'. Customer concentration (note 32, customers with >=10% of revenue, anonymised): Customer A KRW 57,881M (23.8% of H1 revenue), Customer B KRW 47,566M (19.6%), Customer C KRW 30,258M (12.5%) - together KRW 135,704M or 55.9% of H1 2026 revenue vs KRW 109,910M (57.6%) in H1 2025; Customer A grew +44.8% YoY, B +24.8%, C -4.9%. Customer base spans IDMs, fabless, foundry, OSAT (packaging and test) and electronics makers; overseas sales run through distributors plus direct sales to overseas buyers. Filing says AI, data-center, IoT, 5G, VR/AR, autonomous and EV growth is raising test-process difficulty and lifting demand for LEENO PIN / IC TEST SOCKET, and cites WSTS (2026-06-02) forecasting the 2026 semiconductor market at USD 1,511B (+89.9%; memory +249.5%, logic +37.3%). Medical segment: strategic partnership with Siemens since 2010 supplying ultrasound-probe components. Related party Leeno Precision (run by the CEO's brother): H1 sales KRW 220M, purchases KRW 48M.
quarterly_data.figure: No backlog (build-to-order, 10-day standard lead time); top-3 customers 23.8% / 19.6% / 12.5% = 55.9% of H1 rev (KRW 135.7B, +23.5% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex (half-year report): H1 2026 production 35,577,668 LEENO PINs (vs 65,040,211 in all of FY2025), 114,842 IC test sockets (vs 191,102 FY2025) and 1,557,948 medical parts - i.e. pins and sockets both tracked ~20% above the FY2025 run-rate; capacity is not quantified because every product is built to order. Vertical integration: all processes in-house at the Busan Gangseo headquarters plant; raw materials are pipe etc. (KRW 45,418M, 72.4% of H1 purchases) and plating materials (KRW 17,288M, 27.6%) - suppliers withheld as trade secrets, no related-party sourcing, no material price change. NEW PLANT: board approved 2024-11-08 a KRW 97,182M new factory and equipment programme (ex-land) at Busan Eco Delta City Industrial Block 33 for 'production-capacity increase and R&D expansion', investment period 2024-11-11 to 2026-11-10; KRW 78,553,778,109 (80.8%) spent by 2026-06-30 with construction still under way at filing; land bought from K-water for KRW 75,481M (discounted to KRW 74,514M, settled 2024-05-21). Construction-in-progress rose to KRW 157,665M (from KRW 129,496M at 2025-12-31); H1 PP&E additions KRW 41,514M (machinery KRW 12,518M, CIP KRW 28,170M) vs KRW 32,933M capex cash in H1 2025; all self-funded. H1 R&D KRW 6,836M (2.81% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 output 35.6M pins / 114.8k sockets (~+20% vs FY2025 pace); KRW 97.2B new Busan plant 80.8% spent (KRW 78.6B), due 2026-11-10; H1 PP&E adds KRW 41.5B

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline and corporate events (half-year report): R&D results now include a 100GHz-capable socket (0.8mm short-signal pin), a high-ball-count coaxial socket for >5,000-pin / >70x70mm packages, a high-power lid with improved heat dissipation, hybrid conductive-rubber RF sockets (>-60dB isolation), a Cold Temperature (-45C) test socket, fine-pitch wafer-test coaxial interface, IDTC individually heated burn-in sockets for mobile AP, 0.3mm-pitch low-power memory socket, wafer-level probe cards for logic and memory (64/128-para, 300mm), 80um-pitch pins for TSV probe cards, and 200A/600A high-current pins for EV batteries. Planned projects: 'Large Device Test Socket and Lid stabilisation' for 15,000+ pin packages with high load and heat, a water-cooled lid, new-material SI/PI sockets for next-gen high-speed / low-power devices, 55um-pitch pins for wafer-level package probe cards, TSV probe cards and narrow-pitch coaxial pins/sockets. Corporate: eCredible rating raised to AA+ / CR-1 on 2026-04-22 (from AA); Audit Committee introduced at the 2026-03-26 AGM with new independent director Kim Su-rak; CEO/founder Lee Chae-yoon sold 7,000,000 shares off-market on 2026-06-16, cutting his stake from 34.66% to 25.48% (Samsung Asset Management 6.42%, Mirae Asset 5.91%); CFO Choi Yong-ki resigned 2026-08-05, R&D director Lee Seung-chul resigned 2026-07-29; 316,250 treasury shares (0.41%) to be cancelled by September 2027. Stock (058470) traded KRW 62,700-129,000 in H1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 100GHz socket, >5,000-pin coaxial socket and 15,000+ pin large-device socket/lid in pipeline; new plant due 2026-11-10; rating AA+; CEO stake cut to 25.48% (7M shares sold 2026-06-16)
